one_line: Jain scholar-monk of Vallabhi remembered for leading the council that committed the Agamas to writing after centuries of oral transmission.

appearance.age_look: Appears in his late 40s, slim and ascetic but not frail, with a straight, composed posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, wheat-brown Saurashtra complexion, fine straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, soft but focused eyes, and a gentle, reflective default expression hinting at quiet authority.
appearance.hair: Simple short black hair, evenly cropped close to the head (not shaved), with a plain off‑white cloth headband tied around the forehead, knot tucked at the back, keeping the hair orderly.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate Jain monk attire: a full-length unstitched cotton robe (similar to a large dhoti and upper wrap) in plain off‑white, clean and modest, wrapped securely around the waist to the ankles with soft pleats in front, and a separate upper cloth draped over both shoulders and across the chest so the torso is fully covered; no stitched shirt, jewellery, or shoes, just bare but clean feet, with the overall look neat, practical, and scholarly rather than ornate.
appearance.signature: A neatly rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle held in his left hand, tied with a thin dark cord, and a small simple wooden stylus held lightly in his right hand, symbolising the writing down of Jain scriptures.

ref_desc: Devarddhigani Kshamashraman is a late-40s wheat-brown Jain monk with an oval face, short black hair and off-white headband, wearing full off-white wrapped robes to the ankles and bare feet, carrying a tied palm-leaf manuscript and wooden stylus in warm beige-brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Devarddhigani Kshamashraman: a dignified, late-40s Jain scholar-monk from Vallabhi with a slim ascetic build, wheat-brown Saurashtra complexion, oval face, fine straight nose, short neatly cropped black hair and a plain off-white cloth headband tied around his forehead. His expression is gentle and thoughtful, eyes soft yet focused, conveying quiet authority. He wears era-accurate, modest Jain monk garments: a long unstitched off-white cotton lower robe wrapped securely from waist to ankles with soft front pleats, and a separate off-white upper cloth draped over both shoulders and across the chest so the entire torso is fully covered; no stitched shirt, jewellery, or shoes, just clean bare feet. Show the fabric as simple and slightly textured, with subtle folds, not luxurious. In his left hand he holds a neatly rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin dark cord, and in his right hand a small plain wooden stylus, both clearly visible as his signature scholarly tools. Use a restrained palette of off-white for the robes and headband, warm beige for highlights, soft brown for the manuscript and stylus, and black for hair, with subtle shading to keep the look realistic yet suitable for a shonen-anime historical setting; present him from multiple angles in the same outfit to emphasise consistency of face, hair, costume, and props.
